outline:
本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.
schedule:
WEEK 1: Let’s get to know each other!
WEEK 2: Workshop (1)—How to build vocabulary (collocations)
WEEK 3: How Will AI Affect the Arts?
WEEK 4: AI and Human Creativity
WEEK 5: Review session
WEEK 6: The Graphic Trends You'll Want to Bookmark for 2026
WEEK 7: Highlights from Taiwan Design Week's Second Edition
WEEK 8: English Proficiency Test
WEEK 9: Workshop (2)—How to find your dream job
WEEK 10: Unpleasant Design & Hostile Urban Architecture
WEEK 11: Cultural and Creative Parks
WEEK 12: Review session
WEEK 13: Workshop (3)—How to write an English CV
WEEK 14: Bracelet That Translates Sign Language into Speech
WEEK 15: The Curb Cut Effect
WEEK 16: Submit Your CV

flexible_learning.content:
第十七週: Online/Onsite Personalized Feedback
1. 類別: 其他
2. 內容: 與學生進行一對一晤談，討論本學期學習心得並提供英文履歷修改建議
3. 時數: 兩小時
4. 學習成果: 填寫學習訪談問卷
5. 評量比例: 為評量方式"In-Class Activities"項目下的一環，本週成果約占學期總成績2%

第十八週: Improving English during the Winter Vacation
1. 類別: 遠距教學
2. 內容: 以Google Meet方式向學生介紹寒假期間可以自學英文的資源
3. 時數: 兩小時
4. 學習成果: 填寫課程學習單
